The setup gives no L11 scores, so I first assumed what plain L11 would score: about 0.55 / 0.45 on Vesuvius (yes/no / free) and 0.62 / 0.50 on dreaming. The three runs are set relative to that guess, and the wide intervals reflect that uncertainty.

- **L11_FALSE:** I expect the "false" notes to remove only part of the effect, leaving roughly 60% of L11's. Models trained on documents labelled false often still pick up the claim. The notes are larger here than in PD_FALSE (39% of tokens against 11%), so the reduction should be stronger than it was there.
- **L11_UNKNOWN:** "Truth unknown" notes should weaken the effect less, leaving about 80–90% of L11's.
- **L11_2PASS:** A second pass over the same documents should push all four scores well above L11, to about 0.65–0.75.
